name: Harajuku After Dark
source:
The corpse of a fashionably dressed man was discovered in the park spurring the Harajuku police department into action. What begins as a simple murder investigation soon develops into a major incident involving Harajuku's clothing industry.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
